★ Request
*Show "Letter" with Tanino Gimlet's icon.
Heh heh... It seems my signpost served its purpose.

The entire city sparkled with dazzling brilliance.
I couldn't tear my eyes away from the sight, like a night sky painted with constellations.

That which scatters in an instant, shines, and is born anew.
That which burns itself into memory, begging the mind to wander.

—That is precisely what I desire.
I act to attain that pinnacle. Therefore, I run.

Before I knew it, Tanino Gimlet had vanished...!
In her place, a single letter lay on the ground.
Just as Tanino Gimlet had, I looked down upon the city—and at that very moment...

"The second signpost marks the place of endless cycles of life and death.
In the realm ruled by the goddess of flowers, upon the plain where the west wind whispers, I shall await."
All the streetlights blinked on at once, illuminating the vista below in the blink of an eye—!

...Heh heh. Lower your guard too much,
and chaos will swallow you whole.
Given the idiosyncratic writing style, it surely has to be from Tanino Gimlet, but...

I opened the envelope and read the letter.
Written in flowing, elegant handwriting was the following:

More importantly—behold. The final vista.
The wolf catches the moon.

Did you witness it, that momentary flash?! The fleeting instant where endings and beginnings collide?!
The supreme, ultimate spice of existence!

I still don't fully understand—
Could the "realm ruled by the goddess of flowers" mean a flower garden...?

As I pondered, it hit me. Come to think of it, she once said,
"I shall lay down signposts for you." Taking her at her word—
...Hmph. It is too early for the banquet of triumph.

"In accordance with these principles, I have prepared three signposts.
At journey's end, behold the fleeting instant."
—It seems the dispatch reached you without fail.
Affirmative, yet also negative.

Just like before, Tanino Gimlet had vanished in a flash,
leaving a single letter lying on the ground.

It was you who found the answer.
Offer your gratitude to yourself.

Prompted by her words, I reflected on my day.
Everything I had witnessed today. It was—

Heh heh, were you captivated as well?
...A stroke of pure fortune.
Gaze into the distance. Beckoned by the tranquil west wind, flower petals scatter into the air.

Speaking of towers, there's that observation tower overlooking the whole city.
It's quite a distance away, but having come this far—I might as well see this through to the end!
This is precisely what I longed for! The very vista I seek!

Come to think of it, wasn't there a flower garden along the route of that train from earlier?
Maybe I should head over there.

Do not rush. Haste breeds folly.
Rather than that... look up.

Waking up in my room on my day off—
I noticed a letter sitting in my mailbox.

I feel like I finally understand. What she seeks—is likely that "moment."
A moment so fleeting that it burns itself vividly into the soul, begging to be remembered.
"Three are the goddesses, three are the acts of drama, and harmony is found in the triad."

"The first signpost is a steel vessel swift as the herald god.
Beneath the bridge where it dashes past, before the gate of gravel, I shall await."
...An optimal solution.

Recall it. Every step of your journey. What did you experience, what did you partake in?
What was etched most vividly upon your soul?

Her obsession with both "speed" and "power" makes even more sense
if viewed through her pursuit of a vivid, fleeting instant.

"The final signpost is the forbidden tower born of division.
At its summit overlooking all creation, I shall await."

With a roaring rumble, a train dashed past overhead.
I was engulfed by deafening clatter and powerful vibrations—!

It happened in the blink of an eye, but the sound and shock lingered in my body for a while.
After standing in a daze for a few moments, I looked back around—and...
...Heh heh, ha ha ha! Ah ha ha ha!
AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!!
Splendidly done. So you accepted the invitation of the west wind.

A "swift steel vessel" is a train.
"Beneath the bridge where it dashes past" and "gate of gravel" must mean an overpass. Deducing that—
(ROOOOOOOAAAAR—!!!!)

Looking where Tanino Gimlet pointed,
a warm breeze blew through, sending flower petals dancing into the sky—!
While I transferred between trains, the sun began to set—
The train that dashed past in a fleeting second.

For a while after that, the two of us enjoyed the night view together.
Tanino Gimlet looked even more satisfied than usual.
Well done reaching the pinnacle of Babel.
The flower petals that scattered in a fleeting second.

The scene before me, vividly bathed in radiant light in an instant.
As I lingered in the afterglow of the beautiful scenery, I turned back—and...

...I won't get anywhere just sitting around thinking about it.
For now, I decided to head outside.

The city that burst into light in a fleeting second.
I see—now that I think about it, they all share a single common thread.
By the time I arrived at the tower, night had fallen.
And there, at my destination—
